Method of Attack: Modified legitimate add-on to download cryptomining malware
Abuse of update verification system by releasing higher version number to trigger auto-update
Downloading and executing OS-appropriate binary downloader module from C&C server
Deleting Python string that brought in the malware after installation
Impacted Systems: Kodi media player users on Windows
Kodi media player users on Linux
Attack Vector: Compromised third-party Kodi repositories hosting modified add-ons
Auto-update mechanism based on version number
Installation of ready-made Kodi builds containing malicious repository URLs or add-ons
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious add-on script.module.python.requests version 2.16.0 or above
Top affected countries: United States, Israel, Greece, United Kingdom, Netherlands
